usedFor: HelloLeads CRM tracks leads, and Brevo holds your mailing lists when “When Lead Becomes Customer” runs “Add Contacts To List”.

bestTemplate.name: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Add Contacts To List” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A lead that reaches the Won stage joins your chosen Brevo list for customer emails.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” only adds contacts already in Brevo, so the person must exist there first.
